_doc: English lemmas the morphology lessons build their sentences from.
A pack that does not write its own tables can construct them from these:
translate each lemma, then take the cells UniMorph attests for it.
The pools are longer than the tables they fill because a language may
have no entry for a word, or may inflect two of them alike -- German
Schluessel is its own plural, and a head noun whose number is invisible
Pools are also longer than they look because a word may be withheld: where
the dictionary gives two curriculum words the same form both are dropped,
and three of the first six prepositions went that way in French.
